description: This Java class provides static factory methods to create different types of API response objects, such as positive and negative responses, encapsulating response data and status information.

classes.name: ResponseAPI
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods to generate response objects for API interactions.

methods.name: positiveResponse
methods.description: Creates a PositiveResponse object encapsulating the provided data.

methods.name: emptyPositiveResponse
methods.description: Creates a PositiveResponse object with an empty list as data.

methods.name: negativeResponse
methods.description: Creates a NegativeResponse object with status code, message, and result.
